newsitem.title: UK: Microvitec sees year profits below views.
newsitem.headline: Microvitec sees year profits below views.

text.p: British technology firm Microvitec Plc said on Monday its profits for the year would be significantly below expectations.
The company said it was unlikely to break even in the second half due to slower-than-expected market acceptance of new product ranges.
Microvitec's shares plunged over 35 percent, dropping 10.5p to 17.5p by 1335 GMT, making it the top percentage loss leader on the London Stock Exchange.

"The board continues to be confident that the group is well positioned to benefit from the future growth in its market and from the new products that are now coming on line," the company said in a statement.
